日期： Fri, 27 Jun 2025 16:23:56 +0800

"Ph.D. Student Exchange Scholarship" by PSU's Graduate School, is now open for applications, offering support for international students in conducting research and exchange knowledge at PSU.

Key Details:
Degree Level: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)
Application Deadline: 31 July 2025
Eligibility: International Ph.D. student, currently enrolled in a PhD program and maintain student status throughout the research period.

We would greatly appreciate your assistance in sharing this opportunity with eligible candidates within your network.

Further details about the program, eligibility criteria, and the application process can be found in the attached document and via this link: https://link.psu.th/1R9s5p

Should you or your students have any questions or require additional information, please do not hesitate to reach out to PSU's Graduate School at grad@psu.ac.th.
